headline: NetApp (NTAP) Targets Governed Data Discovery Across ONTAP And StorageGRID
summary: NetApp (NasdaqGS:NTAP) and Diskover Data announced a collaboration to integrate governed data discovery into NetApp ONTAP and StorageGRID platforms. The partnership targets media production, semiconductor design, and scientific research workflows that manage large and complex unstructured file data.
